purpose: Rolling Pistol semantic and recommendation authority. Semantic tags remain restricted to the certified feat/talent-used vocabulary; structural rule selectors and comparative weapon metrics are separate non-tag data.

vocabularyPolicy.semanticRule: Every value in sharedTags, advantageTags, tradeoffTags, and finalTags must already be used by at least one certified feat or talent. No weapon-only semantic vocabulary is created.
notes: High/low damage and high/low capacity are structured recommendation comparisons, not semantic tags.
Weapon group/family identifiers are rule selectors, not system.tags.
Accuracy/Inaccurate remains structured weapon mechanics unless represented by an already-certified semantic concept for a distinct positive mechanic.

selectorPolicy.purpose: Connect weapon identities and families to feat/talent/class applicability without polluting semantic tags.
selectorPolicy.genericPistolAbilityRule: Generic pistol feats/talents/classes should match weapon-group:pistol or weapon-proficiency:pistols; do not enumerate every generic pistol ability on every pistol.
selectorPolicy.explicitLinksRule: Use explicit ability links only when the weapon source itself names or modifies a particular ability or ability family.

pistolComparisonPolicy.variantSelectionRule: Prefer a specialized pistol only when its comparative strengths align with the character/build and its tradeoffs do not materially conflict with that build.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Heavy blaster pistol with a swift-action ascension mode that fires a syntherope grappling dart for vertical ascent or downhill zipline movement; blaster mode uses 50 shots, the weapon carries two syntheropes, and its bulk imposes -5 on Stealth checks made to conceal it.

rationale.ranged: Both blaster and ascension modes are ranged-use profiles.
rationale.offense_ranged: Blaster mode functions as a heavy blaster pistol and deals ranged weapon damage.
rationale.stun: The certified weapon authority includes a stun setting.
rationale.nonlethal: The stun setting gives the weapon a nonlethal attack mode.
rationale.mobility: Ascension mode directly transports the wielder vertically or along a zipline.
rationale.movement: The tether moves the wielder at a published 12 squares per round.
rationale.positioning: The tether changes vertical and horizontal battlefield position in ways an ordinary pistol cannot.
rationale.swift_action: Switching between blaster and ascension modes is explicitly a swift action.
rationale.action_economy: The weapon's combat/utility mode switch consumes a defined combat action.
rationale.exploration: The grappling tether and zipline provide explicit traversal utility outside ordinary attacks.

notes: Blaster profile is Inaccurate and cannot attack at long range.
Ascension mode has a 30-square maximum range.
Mode switching costs a swift action.

relativeToStandardPistol.recommendationFit: Strong utility/mobility sidearm for characters who value traversal and positioning and can accept lower ammunition capacity, poor concealability, and no long-range blaster attacks.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Tiny pistol dealing native 3d6 stun damage through high-frequency sonic energy. Deaf creatures are still affected, and only the target hears the weapon, making its firing otherwise silent.

rationale.ranged: It delivers its stun effect through a ranged pistol attack.
rationale.stun: Its only published damage profile is native 3d6 stun.
rationale.nonlethal: It is a dedicated stunning weapon rather than a lethal sidearm.
rationale.stealth: Only the target hears the attack; firing is otherwise silent.
rationale.infiltration: Silent-to-bystanders operation gives it a clear covert-use niche.

notes: Only the target hears the weapon.

relativeToStandardPistol.recommendationFit: Covert nonlethal pistol for infiltration, interrogation, abduction, or quiet takedowns. Unlike ordinary sonic weapons, its defining role here is silent stun delivery rather than anti-Deflect offense.

unrepresentedMechanics.mechanic: Deaf creatures remain affected because the vibrations penetrate the brain.
unrepresentedMechanics.note: No separate semantic tag is needed for this immunity-bypass detail.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: Dedicated nonlethal pistol with native 3d6 stun damage, 50-shot power pack, and a special 20-square maximum range instead of the usual 6-square limit for stun attacks.

rationale.ranged: It attacks at range using pistol proficiency.
rationale.stun: Its only published damage profile is native 3d6 stun.
rationale.nonlethal: The weapon is explicitly designed exclusively for nonlethal use.
rationale.control: Its dedicated purpose is crowd control and subduing targets without lethal injury.

notes: Stun attacks can reach 20 squares instead of the usual 6-square stun limit.

relativeToStandardPistol.recommendationFit: Dedicated ranged nonlethal sidearm. Strong for bounty hunters, police, and capture builds because it preserves 3d6 stun out to 20 squares; useless when lethal damage is required.

unrepresentedMechanics.mechanic: 20-square maximum for native stun attacks.
unrepresentedMechanics.note: The improved stun range is comparison data, not a new semantic tag.

assignments.canonicalMechanicSummary: 3d6 autofire-only pistol with a retractable stock and 50-shot power pack. It cannot be braced for autofire unless the stock is extended; Core retractable-stock rules then treat it as a rifle for proficiency and range while extended.

rationale.ranged: It makes ranged attacks.
rationale.offense_ranged: It deals direct ranged blaster damage.
rationale.sustained_damage: Its defining firing mode is autofire-only, favoring repeated area/suppressive fire rather than single-shot precision.

conditionalRules.note: Core retractable-stock rule changes proficiency and range treatment only; do not infer that every rifle-specific feat/talent applies.
The source explicitly forbids bracing this autofire attack unless the stock is extended.

notes: Pistol treatment by default; rifle proficiency/range treatment with stock extended under Core retractable-stock rules.
Extending/folding a retractable stock uses the Core stock action rule.

relativeToStandardPistol.recommendationFit: Autofire pistol for characters built around sustained/area fire who want a more compact weapon than a rifle. Poor fit for single-shot, stun, or precision pistol builds.

unrepresentedMechanics.mechanic: Autofire-only firing mode and brace restriction.
unrepresentedMechanics.note: No certified `autofire` semantic tag exists; use sustained_damage plus explicit fire-mode rules.
